headline: Kuwaitis and Residents Transfer via Mudhar More Than They Withdraw in Cash: 481,000 Transactions Daily
summary: Mudhar transfers reached KD 6.63 billion in the first seven months of 2026, with 102 million instant transfers against 35.6 million ATM withdrawals. Transfer value rose 34.06%.
why: Instant payment systems shift retail banking activity away from cash, affecting banks' fee income and payment processing.
